## Presence: Larval data

### Run one before simulating many times

```{r}
points <- st_read(here(".//QGIS//waterbodiesClippedRamsar500bufferwithFragAndMajLC.shp"))
# split points into quartiles by mca
points$mcaq <- with(points, cut(menCrAr, 
                                breaks=quantile(menCrAr, probs=seq(0,1, by=0.25), na.rm=TRUE), 
                                include.lowest=TRUE))
```

```{r}
# create dataset 
months <-   month.abb[-c(1:3,10:12)]               # months sampled
larvalSites <- 1:10                                # larval sites per habitat type per area
area <- LETTERS[1:4]                               # 4 Ramsar sites
years <- c(1)
habitat <- c("wood","grass","suburban","arable") # most common land cover types
moz.data <- expand.grid(larvalSites=larvalSites,habitat=habitat,months=months,area=area,years=years)

mcaQ1 <- sample(points$menCrAr[points$mcaq %in% "[0,0.0381]"],length(moz.data$area)/4)
mcaQ2 <- sample(points$menCrAr[points$mcaq %in% "(0.0381,0.115]"],length(moz.data$area)/4)
mcaQ3 <- sample(points$menCrAr[points$mcaq %in% "(0.115,0.326]"],length(moz.data$area)/4)
mcaQ4 <- sample(points$menCrAr[points$mcaq %in% "(0.326,13.6]"],length(moz.data$area)/4)

moz.data$mca[moz.data$habitat %in% "wood"] <- mcaQ4
moz.data$mca[!moz.data$habitat %in% "wood"] <- sample(cbind(mcaQ1,mcaQ2,mcaQ3))

moz.data$row.id <- factor(paste("row", 1:nrow(moz.data), sep = ""))
moz.data$n <- 1

```

```{r}
hist(moz.data$mca)
```

Assume separate effects of majority land class and woodland core mean area 
```{r}
cxpIntercept <- 1.5
mca <- 0.5

bwood  <- 2  
suburb <- 1     
grass  <- 0.5
arabl  <- 0.1
```

### One run before simulating many times

Simulate abundance using GLMMMisc
```{r}
moz.data <-
  sim.glmm(
    design.data = moz.data,
    fixed.eff =
      list(
        intercept = log(cxpIntercept),
         habitat = log(c("wood"=bwood,"grass"=grass,"suburban"=suburb,"arable"=arabl)),
         mca=log(mca)
        ),
    rand.V =               # add in some random effects 
        inv.mor(
         c(months = 1.5)),             
    distribution = "binomial")   
```

Proportion presence
```{r}
sum(moz.data$response)/length(moz.data$response)
```

Summarise and visualise
```{r}
test <- moz.data %>%
  group_by(habitat) %>%
  summarise(propPresent=sum(response)/length(response))

test
```

```{r}
test <- moz.data %>%
  group_by(mca) %>%
  summarise(propPresent=sum(response)/length(response))

test
```


Fit a model
```{r}
mod <- lme4::glmer(response ~ habitat + mca + (1|months), family = "binomial", data = moz.data)
summary(mod)
```

```{r}
output <- summary(mod)
cfs <- output$coefficients
exp(cfs)
```



## Simulate many times
Write a function which does the above
```{r}

pwrFunc <- function(...){
  library("GLMMmisc")
  library("lme4")
  # create dataset - study design first
 # create dataset 
  months <-   month.abb[-c(1:3,10:12)]               # months sampled
  larvalSites <- 1:tS                             # larval sites per habitat type
  area <- LETTERS[1:4]                               # 4 geographic/ council areas e.g. Sefton
  years <- c(1)
  habitat <- c("wood","grass","suburban","arable") # most common land cover types
  moz.data <- expand.grid(larvalSites=larvalSites,habitat=habitat,months=months,area=area,years=years)

  mcaQ1 <- sample(points$menCrAr[points$mcaq %in% "[0,0.0381]"],length(moz.data$area)/4)
  mcaQ2 <- sample(points$menCrAr[points$mcaq %in% "(0.0381,0.115]"],length(moz.data$area)/4)
  mcaQ3 <- sample(points$menCrAr[points$mcaq %in% "(0.115,0.326]"],length(moz.data$area)/4)
  mcaQ4 <- sample(points$menCrAr[points$mcaq %in% "(0.326,13.6]"],length(moz.data$area)/4)

  moz.data$mca[moz.data$habitat %in% "wood"] <- mcaQ4
  moz.data$mca[!moz.data$habitat %in% "wood"] <- sample(cbind(mcaQ1,mcaQ2,mcaQ3))

  moz.data$row.id <- factor(paste("row", 1:nrow(moz.data), sep = ""))
  moz.data$n <- 1


  moz.data <-
   sim.glmm(
     design.data = moz.data,
     fixed.eff =
        list(
          intercept = log(cxpIntercept),
           habitat = log(c("wood"=bwood,"grass"=grass,"suburban"=suburb,"arable"=arabl)),
           mca=log(mca)
         ),
      rand.V =               # add in some random effects 
          inv.mor(
          c(months = monthRand)),             
     distribution = "binomial") 
  
  
  #fit glmm
  mod <- lme4::glmer(response ~ habitat + mca + (1|months), family = "binomial", data = moz.data)
 
   output <- summary(mod)
   cfs<-output$coefficients

   
  cfs <-output$coefficients
  grass <-cfs[2,4]
  suburb <-cfs[3,4]
  arable <-cfs[4,4]
  mca <- cfs[5,4]

  pvalgrass <- 0
  pvalsuburb <- 0
  pvalarable <- 0
  pvalmca <- 0


  if(length(output$optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)==0){
    if(grass<=0.05){pvalgrass<-1}
    if(suburb<=0.05){pvalsuburb<-1}
    if(arable<=0.05){pvalarable<-1}
    if(mca<=0.05){pvalmca<-1}
  }
  return(c(pvalgrass,pvalsuburb,pvalarable,pvalmca))
}

```


Scenario 1
```{r}
monthRand <- 1.5

cxpIntercept <- 1.5
mca <- 0.5

bwood  <- 2  
suburb <- 1     
grass  <- 0.5
arabl  <- 0.1

tS <- 30
```


Run in parallel
```{r}

cl <- makeCluster(detectCores()-1)               # get cores from your computer - 1
clusterExport(cl, varlist=c("pwrFunc","monthRand","mca","points","bwood","suburb","grass","arabl","cxpIntercept","tS"),
              envir=environment())               


start <- Sys.time()
sim.res <- parLapply(cl,1:100,pwrFunc) 
stopCluster(cl)   # stop the clusters
end <- Sys.time()
end - start

```


Calculate power to detect a difference
```{r}
l <- do.call(rbind,sim.res)
l2 <- rowSums(l)

# Power
length(l2[l2==4])/100*100
```

### Simulate across different sample sizes and assumed effect sizes

```{r}
sampleSizes <- c(10,15,20,25,30,25,40,45,50)

sims <- lapply(sampleSizes,function(x){
  cl <- makeCluster(detectCores()-1)               # get cores from your computer - 1
  clusterExport(cl, varlist=c("pwrFunc","monthRand","mca","points","bwood","suburb","grass","arabl","cxpIntercept","tS"),
              envir=environment())               

  sim.res <- parLapply(cl,1:1000,pwrFunc,totalSites=x) 
  stopCluster(cl)
  
  l <- do.call(rbind,sim.res)
  l2 <- rowSums(l)

# Power
pwr <- length(l2[l2==4])/1000*100
return(pwr)
})

```

```{r}
pwrsim <- cbind.data.frame(sampleSizes, pwr=do.call(rbind,sims))
```

```{r}
ggplot(pwrsim) +
  geom_point(aes(sampleSizes,pwr))
```
With the current set of coefficients and with three covariates, plus some random effect of month to get near 80% need c. 100 sites per year per area
